description:
Label the causal market regimes (high_vol, drawdown, chop, melt_up, gap_heavy) over
cached bars and report the episode pool per regime, flagging thin pools. Labels use
trailing data only — no lookahead.

bars.description: Optional inline OHLCV rows [{symbol, ts, open, high, low, close, volume}].
bars.title: Bars

min_symbols.description: Minimum symbols required for a valid episode pool.
min_symbols.title: Min Symbols

symbols.description: Optional tickers served from the shared cache; omit when passing your own bars.
symbols.title: Symbols
